integrity: A complete algebraic proof and a separately executable finite-field consistency checker are supplied. Mathematical statements have self-review only, with no independent audit or validation.
limitations: Reduced commuting varieties of the exterior algebra on exactly four generators; no radicality assertion for original equation ideal, larger-generator classification, or conjugacy-orbit count. Finite checks are not an infinite proof. Historical novelty is provisional.
title: All-arity commuting geometry of the four-generator exterior algebra
